Монитор системы для macOS\n\nРазработчик:
System monitor for macOS

Developer: Arsen Kocharyan
Имя приложения или процесса. Строка прил: Application or process name. An app row combines its process metrics. The arrow expands processes; clicking the name opens a summary.
PID — идентификатор процесса в macOS. Дл: PID identifies a process in macOS. For an application, the main process PID is shown. It usually changes after a restart.
Загрузка процессора за последний интерва: CPU usage over the latest sample interval. 100% means one fully used core; several cores can exceed 100%. Application rows sum all their processes.
Память (footprint) — объём памяти, учиты: Memory footprint attributed to a process by macOS, including compressed pages. Application rows sum their processes; RSS is used if footprint is unavailable. Shared pages may be counted more than once.
RSS (Resident Set Size) — объём резидент: RSS (Resident Set Size) counts a process's resident pages in physical RAM, excluding swapped-out and compressed pages. Shared pages may appear in multiple processes, so total RSS does not equal the Mac's total RAM usage.
Количество процессов в группе приложения: Number of processes in an application's group: main process, helper services, renderers, agents and other child processes.
Скорость чтения данных процессами с диск: Process disk read rate over the latest interval, in B/s, KB/s or MB/s. Application rows sum available process counters. May differ from physical SSD activity. “—” means no data yet.
Скорость записи данных процессами на дис: Process disk write rate over the latest interval, in B/s, KB/s or MB/s. Application rows sum available process counters. May differ from physical SSD activity. “—” means no data yet.
Время с запуска процесса. Для приложения: Time since process launch. For an application, this starts with its main process; helper processes may have launched later.
Readings are grouped by component. The highest reading in each group appears on the right. Hover over a sensor to see its macOS name.
Сохрани документы. {0} будет закрыто обы: Save your documents. {0} will receive a normal quit request and reopen.
История текущего сеанса, до 2 минут: Current session history, up to 2 minutes
В списке приложений 100% соответствует о: In the application list, 100% corresponds to one core.
Нажми строку для сводки, стрелку — для п: Click a row for its summary or the arrow for processes. Memory sums process footprints; shared pages may be counted more than once.
Место на томе пользователя. I/O суммируе: Space on the user volume. I/O is summed across available physical disks.
I/O отдельных процессов — в деталях прил: Per-process I/O is in the application details.
VPN и локальный трафик отдельно не сумми: VPN and local traffic are not added separately, to avoid double counting. This is current throughput, not your plan's connection speed.
Общая загрузка GPU из счётчиков драйвера: Total GPU usage from driver counters. Apple Silicon uses shared memory, not dedicated VRAM. Per-process GPU metrics are currently unavailable.
Максимальное показание среди датчиков эт: Highest sensor reading in this group, not the component's average temperature.
macOS не предоставила доступных датчиков: macOS did not provide any available sensors.
Температура в разных участках чипа. Точн: Temperatures across the chip. macOS does not provide an exact mapping to individual cores.
Sensors identified by macOS as CPU.
Sensors identified by macOS as GPU.
Температура датчиков накопителя; может о: Storage sensor temperature; may differ from the controller temperature.
Дополнительные точки измерения. Их точно: Additional measurement points. macOS does not disclose their exact locations.
Аптайм, загрузка системы, время без сна,: Uptime, system load, awake time, wake events and Mac information
Непрерывный монотонный счётчик с загрузк: A continuous monotonic counter since boot, including sleep. Unaffected by changes to the calendar clock.
Время работы системы без сна. Это не вре: System uptime excluding sleep. This is not user activity time: an idle Mac still counts.
Расчётная разница между счётчиками с учё: Estimated difference between the counters including and excluding sleep. Background wakes may count as awake time.
System Sleep Count from pmset. Updates about once a minute.
Dark Wake Count из pmset: пробуждения дл: Dark Wake Count from pmset: wakes for background tasks that can occur without turning on the display.
User Wake Count из pmset. Это счётчик си: User Wake Count from pmset. This is a system counter, not a count of user logins.
Последние события отслеживаются только с: Recent events are tracked only while Systra runs. System sleep counters update once a minute; they are not a reboot history.
Средняя системная нагрузка за 1, 5 и 15: Average system load over 1, 5 and 15 minutes. These are not CPU percentages; compare them with the number of logical cores.
Язык меняется сразу во всех окнах и меню: Language changes immediately in every window and menu.
